# Pipeline Kit

> Portable workflow pack and installer for coding agents. Process lives in `.pipeline`. The IDE is a thin adapter.

- [What is Pipeline Kit](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/intro/what-is-pipeline-kit): Product definition, what lands after install, shipped workflows.
- [Problems it solves](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/intro/problems): Context explosion, IDE lock-in, customer leakage, install, wrong ladder, hard to extend.
- [How it works](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/intro/how-it-works): Pack vs adapter, workflows, allowlists, config overlay, install scopes.
- [Who it is for](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/intro/who-it-is-for): New users, developers, architects, maintainers.
- [Prerequisites](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/getting-started/prerequisites): Python 3.11+, optional IDE and plugin tools.
- [Install the CLI](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/getting-started/install-cli): uv, pipx, or ./install.sh.
- [Where you can install](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/getting-started/install-scopes): Project vs user pack, override order.
- [IDE adapters](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/getting-started/ide-adapters): Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub, none.
- [First project](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/getting-started/first-project): init, doctor, workflows.
- [Your first workflow](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/getting-started/first-workflow): ask vs a small feature change.
- [New-project checklist](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/getting-started/checklist): AGENTS.md, config, deploy, gitignore, smoke test.
- [Capabilities overview](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/capabilities/overview): Core vs opt-in.
- [Workflows and change classes](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/capabilities/workflows): Named procedures and micro/minor/feature.
- [Planning gates and waves](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/capabilities/planning-gates): Sign-off order and one tester.
- [Knowledge base](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/capabilities/knowledge): Opt-in QA overlay.
- [Plugins](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/capabilities/plugins): Optional Graphify and Archify.
- [Graphify plugin](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/capabilities/graphify): Official graph extract.
- [Archify plugin](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/capabilities/archify): Pinned HTML diagrams; mermaid required.
- [Agent-run observability](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/capabilities/observability): Ledger, Langfuse, scores.
- [App telemetry vs agent observability](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/capabilities/telemetry): Two different products.
- [Feature flags](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/capabilities/feature-flags): config.json toggles.
- [Wiki / agent memory](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/capabilities/wiki): Trigger-routed pages.
- [Loader and allowlists](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/capabilities/loader): Per-step allowed_reads.
- [Ask workflow](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/workflows/ask): Read-only Q&A.
- [Feature development](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/workflows/feature-development): Chat-driven product work.
- [Jira workflows](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/workflows/jira): Story, epic, bug.
- [Knowledge bootstrap](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/workflows/knowledge-bootstrap): Curator-only workflow.
- [Adapt AGENTS.md](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/guides/agents-md): Routing table.
- [Adapt config.json](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/guides/config): verify, deploy, Jira.
- [Adapt local deploy](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/guides/local-deploy): Runbook and script.
- [Adapt tests](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/guides/tests): Point testers at your runners.
- [Git ignore](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/guides/gitignore): features/ and state.
- [Add a workflow](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/guides/add-workflow): Skill, JSON, config, loader.
- [What you should not edit](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/guides/what-not-to-edit): Loader, secrets, planning skills.
- [Cursor adapter](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/adapters/cursor)
- [Claude Code adapter](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/adapters/claude-code)
- [GitHub adapter](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/adapters/github)
- [No IDE](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/adapters/none)
- [CLI reference](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/reference/cli)
- [config.json reference](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/reference/config)
- [Pack layout](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/reference/pack-layout)
- [Agent roster](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/reference/agents)
- [Skills](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/reference/skills)
- [Document standard](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/reference/document-standard)
- [Troubleshooting](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/troubleshooting)
- [Tracker intake](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/troubleshooting/jira-intake)
- [Slim handoffs](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/troubleshooting/slim-handoffs)
- [Interrupted Task](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/troubleshooting/interrupted-task)
- [Deploy listeners](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/troubleshooting/deploy-listeners)
- [UI copy split](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/troubleshooting/ui-copy)
- [IDE hooks](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/troubleshooting/hooks)
- [Retro](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/troubleshooting/retro)
- [Test layers](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/troubleshooting/test-layers)
- [Observability troubleshooting](http://127.0.0.1:3000/docs/troubleshooting/observability)
